prompt: I need to move data from OpenBoxes to openIMIS: pull the newest product, set its dateCreated to today's date, and post it to openIMIS as a medication.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-openboxes@latest'
    body: |
      get('products', { query: { max: 1, sort: 'dateCreated', order: 'desc' } });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-openimis@latest'
    body: |
      http.post('/api_fhir_r4/Medication', state => {
        const p = state.data.data[0];
        return { resourceType: 'Medication', code: { text: p.name }, identifier: [{ value: p.productCode }] };
      });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
